_about: Start harvest (10-Oct-2026): save carried-context checkpoints at the stuck levels that have none. The seven games without a saved start warm up from the level before (winning line to that level, the model clears it and carries its context in), two lanes each, and play on through the game, so every level start they reach is saved. Deck Control and Locksmith start from their saved level-5 start and play on for the deeper stuck levels (Deck Control 6, Locksmith 6-7). Run with the notebook's LANE_START = '' so these starts apply, and a long clock.
